definitions: A declarative UI framework developed by JetBrains, based on Kotlin, for building user interfaces that run on multiple platforms from a single codebase.
A technology that enables developers to create native-looking applications for Android, iOS, desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux), and web using a shared UI and business logic.
examples: Learning Compose Multiplatform can boost productivity.
Many companies are adopting Compose Multiplatform.
